habit.definition: A habit is something that you do regularly.
habit.sentence: John, don't bite your fingernails. It's a bad habit.

hair.definition: Hair is long, very thin, soft material that grows on people and animals.
hair.sentence: She had never seen him with his hair cut short.

half.definition: A half is 1/2 of a whole; 50%.
half.sentence: Sales were down from January to June but jumped in the second half of the year.

hall.definition: A hall is a large space with a roof and walls. It can be a kind of large building, or a room or part of a building. Most commonly, it is the area just inside the front door.
hall.sentence: Please leave your boots in the front hall.

hand.definition: Your hands are the parts of your body at the end of your arms. A hand has four fingers and a thumb.
hand.sentence: Mother, I'm afraid, please hold my hand.

handle.definition: A handle is the part of an object that you hold with your hand when you want to use or move the object. Some examples of handles are: the shaft of a sword, the knob of a door, etc.
handle.sentence: I grabbed the handle on the drawer and opened it.

hang.definition: When you hang things, you put something above the ground and with no support below using rope, wire, or some other means.
hang.sentence: Now, I hang this picture on the wall.

happen.definition: If something happens, it starts or changes without a plan.
happen.sentence: Did anything happen at school today?

happiness.definition: Happiness is the emotion of being happy; joy.
happiness.sentence: I hope that your new job brings you happiness.

happy.definition: When you feel happy, you feel good, usually because something nice has happened.

harbor.definition: A harbor is some water in a curve of land where it's safe for boats because there are no big waves.
harbor.sentence: A ship in the harbor is safe -- but that is not what ships are for.

hard.definition: If something is hard, it is not soft.
hard.sentence: I kicked the wall and hurt my foot. The wall is hard.

harm.definition: To harm someone means to hurt someone; to injure someone.
harm.sentence: In the attack, he caused her serious bodily harm.

hat.definition: A hat is a piece of clothing that you wear on your head.
hat.sentence: A poke bonnet is an old-fashioned woman's hat that covers the hair and shades the face with a rim.

hate.definition: If you hate something you dislike it strongly.

have.definition: Someone has something if the thing is in their hands. The person is holding or gripping it.
have.sentence: Do you have a spoon, or do you need me to give you one so you can eat the soup?

he.definition: A he refers to a male person.

head.definition: The head is the highest and most important part of the body.
head.sentence: He put his head on the desk and fell asleep.

health.definition: If you talk about the health of a person or animal, you are talking about whether they are sick or not.
health.sentence: The doctors believe that the disease will not be a serious danger to public health.

healthy.definition: A healthy person is someone who is not sick. They are strong and will probably live a long time.
healthy.sentence: I need three young, healthy people to help me.

hear.definition: If you hear a sound, you notice it with your ear.
hear.sentence: Speak louder, I cannot hear you!

heart.definition: The part of the body that pumps blood.
heart.sentence: He has a problem with his heart.

heat.definition: Heat is a kind of energy. It is the quality things have when they are warm or hot.
heat.sentence: This is a good coat. It keeps the heat in.

heavily.definition: Heavily is a quality of heavy, a great weight, load, effort, or to a large amount.
heavily.sentence: He dragged himself heavily out of the water and onto the boat.

height.definition: The distance of something from the bottom of it to the top; how tall something is.
height.sentence: At the height of her career.

hell.definition: Something that is very hard to do or makes you suffer.

hello.definition: You say, "hello" in greeting when you meet someone new or someone you know.

help.definition: If you help another person do something, you do things to make it easier for them to do the thing, or you do part of it for them.
help.sentence: Will you please help me wash the dishes?

helpful.definition: If something is helpful it can or does help in some way.
helpful.sentence: The way you explained that word was very helpful to me.

here.definition: In or at this place; where the speaker or writer is.

hero.definition: A hero is a person who is very brave and does great things. The hero may be real or not real, and often defeats dangerous enemies of the people.
hero.sentence: Leonardo DaVinci used to be my hero.

hesitate.definition: When someone hesitates, they have doubts about something and therefore do not act, or stop the action.
hesitate.sentence: Authorities hesitate to quote exact figures.

hi.definition: You say "hi" in greeting when you meet or see somebody.

hide.definition: When you hide something, you put it where others will not find it.
hide.sentence: I hide candy to keep it from my brother.

high.definition: If something is high, it is a long way up.

highlight.definition: If you highlight something, you make it more noticeable or obvious.
highlight.sentence: I usually use a pen to highlight the important section in my textbook.

highly.sentence: The two ideas are highly connected.

hill.definition: A hill is a piece of high ground that rises up out of lower ground. A hill is like a mountain but smaller.
hill.sentence: My house was on the top of a hill.

hint.definition: A hint is a clue to a question or a puzzle.
hint.sentence: I really need a hint to solve this question. It is too difficult for me.

hire.definition: If someone hires you, they agree to give you a job and pay you money.

historian.definition: A historian is a person who studies or writes about history.

historic.definition: If something is historic, it is important to history.
historic.sentence: This historic event will be remembered for generations.

historical.definition: Historical events, record, leaders, etc. all relate to things that happened in the distant past.
historical.sentence: We tried to look at the problem in its historical context, not just how it is today.

history.definition: History is what happened in the past.
history.sentence: China has many old books about its history.

hit.definition: If you hit someone or something, then you touch them hard and fast.
hit.sentence: The red car was turning when the blue car hit it.

hold.definition: When you hold something, you put it in your hand and keep it there.
hold.sentence: The police hold people who do crimes in prison.

holder.definition: A holder is a thing that holds.
holder.sentence: Put your umbrella in the umbrella holder.

hole.definition: A hole is an empty space in an object or material.
hole.sentence: He fell into the water through a hole in the ice.

holiday.definition: A holiday is a day when people don't go to work or school, often because there is a religious celebration.
holiday.sentence: In North America, Christmas is the biggest holiday of the year.

home.definition: Where a person lives. Usually, where people keep their things that they are not carrying, and where they sleep.
home.sentence: Deliver the package to my home.

honest.definition: If you are honest, you do not hide the truth; you don't lie, cheat, or steal.
honest.sentence: My father is a very straight, very honest man; everyone trusts him.

honor.definition: Honor is the quality of being respected by other people.

hook.definition: A hook is a curved, sharp thing, usually made of metal and often small. Someone can put the hook through a hole in something to grip it so that they can pull the thing.

hope.definition: When someone hopes that something will happen, it means that they want it to happen and they think it may happen.
hope.sentence: We hope that more women will decide to join the course.

hopefully.definition: You use hopefully to show what you want to happen.
hopefully.sentence: Hopefully, the rain will stop by morning.

horrible.definition: If something is horrible, it is very bad.
horrible.sentence: My God, these things are horrible. I can't believe they happened.

horse.definition: A horse is a hoofed mammal. It walks on four (4) legs. People often ride on horses.
horse.sentence: The horse likes to eat oats.

hospital.definition: A building for sick people, with doctors and nurses.
hospital.sentence: Mary had an accident. She will be in hospital for a week.

host.definition: A host is a person or animal who makes a place for others and usually provides food and drink.
host.sentence: The host of the party was so busy, she didn't have time to eat.

hot.definition: Something that is hot is high in temperature.

hotel.definition: A hotel is a place where people pay to stay in a room overnight, usually for only a few days.
hotel.sentence: We fly to Taipei and stay at the Hilton hotel for three days and two nights.

hour.definition: A measure of time, equal to 60 minutes.
hour.sentence: The job will take more than an hour.

house.definition: A house is a building that one family lives in.
house.sentence: He has a house on Cape Cod.

household.definition: A group of people who live together; the group may or may not be a family. A household may also be an individual living alone.
household.sentence: How many people are there in your household?

how.definition: The word how is used to ask about the way something happens or the way people do things.
how.sentence: How will we ever solve this problem?

however.definition: You use however to show that there is a contrast between two ideas.
however.sentence: It was very long. However, it was not long enough.

huge.definition: If something is huge it is very big. When you say this, you mean bigger than large, or bigger than what is usually called big.
huge.sentence: Wow! That dog is so huge he could be a horse.

human.definition: Human rights, life, nature, etc. belong or relate to people, not machines or animals.

humor.definition: Humor is ideas that make people laugh: jokes, funny things.
humor.sentence: I like the stories she tells because they're full of humor.

hunger.definition: Hunger is the feeling when wanting food when your stomach is empty.
hunger.sentence: When I have hunger then I want to have some food.

hunt.definition: If you hunt for something, you look for it very carefully.
hunt.sentence: The King used to hunt these forests.

hurry.definition: If you hurry, you move or work quickly.
hurry.sentence: After the speech, he had to hurry out the door to the waiting car.

hurt.definition: If a person hurts someone, they make them feel pain.
hurt.sentence: Don't hurt your brother or I'll send you to your room.

husband.definition: A husband is a married man.

hypothesis.definition: A hypothesis is a guess about what will happen, usually in scientific experiments.
hypothesis.sentence: We will test the hypothesis that the change will have no effect.
